response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS account_sum, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, txn_count, CAST(account_sum AS REAL) / SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS share FROM acct ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The request explicitly says to sum the stored unsigned amount over all transactions, so credits, withdrawals and VYBER rows are all added as positive values without sign adjustment.
Ties in share are not broken by any specified order, so which tied rows fall in the top 10 is arbitrary.
